# Shortcut profiles — SoundCraft / SML Studio 0.5.0

<!-- GENERATED by `cargo xtask docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The two built-in profiles of Setup › Keyboard Shortcuts…, as compiled into this build, with Windows/Linux key names (`Cmd` = `Ctrl`; a macOS-only chord with both is omitted). The app runs the **first** row for each chord; a later row with the same chord never fires (marked *shadowed* below, with what the key actually runs). Custom = one of these plus your own overrides (stored in your settings, not listed here). Limits that apply to every profile: keypad keys cannot be told from the main-row keys, and the Windows key is not reported to the app, so chords that need either cannot be delivered (the Nudge panel and command search always work). See [USER_GUIDE.md](../USER_GUIDE.md#21-shortcut-profiles).
